senses.gloss: (tradit. pronunc. הֲלָה) m. (cmp. הָלָא) that one there, this one; (mostly in legal proceedings) the person concerned.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shevuot 6:6">Shebu. VI, 6</cite>, sq. <he>וה׳ אומר וכ׳</he> and the defendant says &c.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 113b">B. Mets. 113ᵇ</cite>; a. v. fr. [<cite ref="Mishnah Eduyot 4:9">Eduy. IV, 9</cite> <he>ה׳ תצא</he> fem., v. <cite ref="E00544"><he>הַלָּז</he></cite>.]—Pl. <he>הֲלָלוּ</he>.
<cite ref="Eruvin 54a:5">Erub. 54ᵃ</cite> <he>ה׳ נוצצין וה׳ וכ׳</he> these blossom and those fade.
<cite ref="Horayot 14a:1">Hor. 14ᵃ</cite> <he>מי הם ה׳ שמימיהם וכ׳</he> who are those whose waters we drink &c.?—
<cite ref="Beitzah 15b:13">Bets. 15ᵇ</cite> <he>ה׳ בעלי וכ׳</he> these here (now leaving the assembly) are &c.; a. fr.
